title: The Weighted Dual Minkowski Problem Under Group Symmetry
summary: The paper studies the weighted dual Minkowski problem for the weighted $q$th dual curvature measure of convex bodies in $\mathbb R^n$ first posed by Huang, Lutwak, Yang, and Zhang. Most of the results are in the G-invariant setting, i.e. when the convex bodies are invariant under a closed subgroup $G$ of $O(n)$. They generalize previous results on the existence of solutions to the dual Minkowski problem for origin-symmetric convex bodies.
